equivalence_argument: For both datasets min_train=0. Therefore (x-min_train)/(max_train-min_train) equals x/max_train. Every training value is at most max_train, so clip(x/max_train,0,1) also equals x/max_train on every training pixel. The two arms would train on identical tensors.
why_non_clipping_is_used: The intended PET protocol uses one dataset-wide constant for input and target. Clipping validation values would alter quantitative target activity and would turn a normalization comparison into a target-definition change.

classification.train_max_fixed_C: development training configuration; data-derived fixed scale, not physical
classification.train_global_minmax: redundant training arm; validation clipping diagnostic only
classification.per_image_minmax: diagnostic only; prohibited for PET input and target

test_status: No untouched test subjects are registered; this decision authorizes development training and validation only.
